prompt: Which country was affected by Black Monday and experienced a prolonged recession, continuing its decline for an extended period after other global markets had recovered?
answer: New Zealand. Its stock market suffered a particularly long and deep decline after the 1987 Black Monday crash, continuing to fall even after many other global markets had recovered.
